newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG ups stake in Sokolow.
newsitem.headline: BIG ups stake in Sokolow.

text.p: Polish Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA's (BIG) subsidiary Bel Leasing Sp z oo has upped its stake in meat processing firm Sokolow SA to 22 percent from earlier 19.4 percent, BIG's spokesman said.

Wojciech Kaczorowski told Reuters on Monday the bank was analyzing the situation in the firm and would later decide whether to keep its stake in Sokolow on the current level, increase it or sell the shares.
"We are constantly analyzing the situation of the firm and it will depend on the analyses whether we will expand our stake or not," he said.

Kaczorowski said BIG started buying shares in Sokolow late last year and later gradually increased the stake to the current 22 percent, because its analysts believed Sokolow's shares were undervalued and had growth potential.
